text:
casey: Customer hit a 500 on /v1/generate, provided request_id 01EYX8K6ZQ9T4A2B0C3D. They say it happened around 10:23 PDT. Can someone try to find server-side logs?

maria: I can take a pass. Quick Q: did they provide a full curl or just the request_id?

casey: Only the request_id and a short repro (simple prompt). They included a json snippet of headers. No debug bundle yet.

maria: Ok — first step: check hot indices then archived shards. Hot retention is 21 days, cold/archived up to 90 days but need archive lookup. I ran a quick KQL for the hot cluster: 

```
request_id: "01EYX8K6ZQ9T4A2B0C3D" or tags.request_id: "01EYX8K6ZQ9T4A2B0C3D"
| sort @timestamp desc
```

maria: No hits in hot. Prob moved to cold. @log-archiver-bot can you pull shard mapping for that day?

log-archiver-bot: pulling shard list for 2026-03-12 -> archived-index-2026-03-12-az1. ETA 3m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

danielle: While we wait, can we ask the customer for a curl repro? If it's easy we can reproduce and get a new request_id (and stacktrace) from our side. Example curl to ask them to run: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium-v1","input":"short prompt to repro"}'
```

casey: Sent customer the curl and asked for time-window + any extra headers. Also asked them to attach the debug bundle (browser/dev logs).

matt: Archive lookup returned a candidate shard. Quick KQL to pull the log slice (use the archive proxy query): 

```
index: archived-index-2026-03-12-az1
| where request_id == "01EYX8K6ZQ9T4A2B0C3D"
| project @timestamp, service, node, level, message
| sort by @timestamp desc
```

matt: Found two entries: an upstream timeout at the runtime layer and then a 500 returned by the gateway. Looks like KV cache miss + backend slow path. Attaching log excerpt below.

maria: Great, can you paste the small excerpt here (sanitized)? We need to confirm if the backend returned a model error or we hit infra resource limits.

matt: paste: "[runtime-node-7] [ERROR] request_id=01EYX8K6ZQ9T4A2B0C3D - backend call timeout after 15s, downstream=gpu-pool-4, op=generate, seq_len=512"

danielle: That suggests a model execution slowdown. Next steps: 1) ask support to check if customer had large seq_len or reties in client; 2) open an infra ticket to check GPU pool saturation around 10:20-10:30 PDT; 3) recommend we provide a targeted canary rerun if customer approves.

casey: Customer replied — they used a long prompt (~1.2k tokens) and had 2 retries. Sharing their debug bundle now.

maria: With that info it lines up. I'll open an incident ticket with the shard and log excerpt, mark as P2, and link this thread. Also setting retention note: we need to remind support that hot logs only 21d, and archived pulls require 24h for some regions (and sometimes a small charge).

casey: Thanks all — assigning to infra (danielle + matt) to confirm GPU saturation, and I'll coordinate debug bundle handoff to eng if we need deeper traces. :thumbsup:
